current_utc_offset_seconds.description: Observed offset at connection time. Historical rows are never converted with this value because daylight-saving rules may differ at row time.

effective_time_zone.description: Session zone unless it is `SYSTEM`, then the server-reported system zone.

session_time_zone.description: Effective time zone of the exact StarRocks session used by the connector.

system_time_zone.description: FE host time zone reported by StarRocks. This resolves a session value of `SYSTEM` without guessing from the application host.
